player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Each round, guess a number between {min_guess} and {max_guess}.
After both guesses, the target is (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
and the player whose guess is closest to the target wins that round.
Reply with your guess in the format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: अवैध प्रारूप; कृपया अपना अनुमान [<number>] के रूप मे जमा करे।
invalid_move.out_of_range: اخہرال Guess چھے {min_guess} تہٕ {max_guess} درمیان ہونہٕ چھے۔

message.round_guesses: Player 0 نے {guess0} اخہرال؛ Player 1 نے {guess1} اخہرال۔ اسٕ تہٕ Target چھے: {target}۔

outcome.draw: कुल मिलाप पेठ छी ये ड्राई.
